name: GW2 Trading Post

description: Shows Guild Wars 2 wallet gold and trading post listing values

schema.label: GW2 API key
schema.description: Guild Wars 2 API key with Account and Wallet permissions. Read first, ahead of $GW2_API_TOKEN and ~/.config/omarchy/gw2-api-token. Paste it in the panel's Settings view.
